text: ConvolvedTerm retains a representative HRF and optional column HRFs but not the complete per-event assignment, precision, summate and condition-lowering recipe used by EventTerm.convolve/convolveByCondition/convolvePerEvent. Add typed retained recipes and native support review bound to exact retained sample indices and SourceEventRow records. Use existing SampledEventSupport; preserve actual shared/per-event evaluation semantics, basis cardinality, scaling and source/condition identity. Distinguish temporal potential with unit input from actual zero modulation and aggregate cancellation. Unknown hand-built recipes must be explicit, never guessed. Test beta/FIR, per-event and per-cell HRFs, censored scans, negative/late events and source-addressable summaries on JVM/JS plus consumer. Event exclusions require a separate explicit compiler policy before selection-dependent centering or modulation transforms.
